g.text: Colored outer boundary; segments show multiple memberships
D1, D2, D3: minimum directed steps from RPL11
All direct RPL11 edges: 0 incoming, 9 outgoing
Deeper mitochondrial hits retained at 4/20 or more
Thick black border: recurrent mitochondrial query hit
Node size and x/20 show neighborhood recurrence
Radial position groups nodes by minimum downstream distance; arrows follow the Bayesian-network direction
